controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour from Gaia's spectrum of the star. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The colour of the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum. No limb darkening is drawn: at 3,030 K and log g 5.04 no model grid used here reaches it (Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 (ATLAS): 3030 is outside the grid 3500, 3750, 4000.; Reeve & Howarth (2016), MNRAS 456, 1294 (non-LTE TLUSTY): 3030 is outside the grid 27500, 30000, 32500, 35000, 37500, 40000, 42500, 45000, 47500, 50000, 52500, 55000.; Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 (PHOENIX): The grid must hold exactly one node at 3000 K, log g 5.). The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.
